versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Purpose of meta-class BinaryManifestRe- sourceDefinition The purpose of meta-class BinaryManifestResourceDef- inition is to provide attributes that apply (by definition) to all BinaryManifestRe- source s that refer to a specific BinaryManifestResourceDefinition . In other words, the configuration modeled in a BinaryManifestResourceDefini- tion is shared among all BinaryManifestResource s that reference the Binary- ManifestResourceDefinition .
